name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for a second-story deck project?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for a second-story deck project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before contacting Hometelligent Inc. for a second-story deck project, it is helpful to consider your desired deck size, preferred materials, approximate budget, and any specific features you envision (e.g., stairs, railings, built-in seating). Gathering any existing property surveys or architectural plans for your home can also streamline the initial consultation. This preparation helps us understand your vision and provide a more accurate assessment and estimate.
